Both are already linked to 138 common concepts, including classification performance, field size and nnu net, which suggests the methods and data needed to connect them already exist. We propose a study that uses classification performance as a bridge: first, review how malignancy and treatment outcome are each currently treated through classification performance; second, design an approach that combines them and test it on established benchmarks from both lines of work; third, measure whether the combination improves on each topic studied alone. We expect the work to clarify where the two literatures overlap and to open a new line of research between them.

We propose a study that uses segmentation performance as a bridge: first, review how automatic segmentation and diabetic retinopathy are each currently treated through segmentation performance; second, design an approach that combines them and test it on established benchmarks from both lines of work; third, measure whether the combination improves on each topic studied alone. We expect the work to clarify where the two literatures overlap and to open a new line of research between them.
medicine-249-1093.phd: A 3-4 year programme building a unified framework for automatic segmentation and diabetic retinopathy. Year 1: systematic review of the 55 shared concepts (starting with segmentation performance, automated segmentation and receiver operating characteristic curve); years 2-3: develop and validate a joint method; year 4: generalise it and release open tools and data.
medicine-249-1093.masters: A 6-12 month project: reproduce one recent automatic segmentation study and one recent diabetic retinopathy study, then run a focused experiment combining the two through segmentation performance, reporting what transfers and what does not.
medicine-249-1093.industry: Illustrative example only (no claim about the firm's actual work): an industry research team such as Marshall Wace could run a short feasibility study testing whether combining automatic segmentation with diabetic retinopathy via segmentation performance adds measurable value to an existing medicine pipeline, then decide whether to invest further.
